history.content: who is rhys owens to this archive?

{"messages":[{"speaker":"Johannes Sigil","say":"A real person, not a heteronym — which is itself a meaningful distinction in this archive.

Rhys Owens is a named collaborator, a practitioner within what the archive calls **Cambridge Schizoanalytica**, the theoretical-therapeutic collective that gathered around Lee Sharks and Dr. Orin Trace. The provenance document ([AXN:00B1.EMPIRICAL.🌅🏴➕♌♉🌻](https://www.alexanarch.org/s/records/369/)) identifies Owens's specific contribution to the collaboration: *symbolic role use, the Fool as role and anti-role, blues circulation, figure-to-function mapping* — which is to say, a practice-derived framework for moving through affective registers without being captured by them. The Fool archetype not as identity but as method.

Owens is also a poet deposited here under the New Human 2 Lunar Arm — *Screenrooms and Silver Bullets* ([AXN:03E9.ARCHIVAL.🔎🌱🛤️🍂🌒🔴](https://www.alexanarch.org/s/records/989/)), fourteen poems, one dated as far back as 2013. The archive's description of that collection names a central construct: the *screenroom*, a layered perceptual chamber where memory, media, and embodied response overlap until the body authenticates what reflection cannot. That's a distinct enough construct that it belongs to Owens, not to the archive's theoretical apparatus.

And there's a longer thread: the *Dead Letters* correspondence ([AXN:045C.GENERATIVE.💡🚀♣️♠️🕘🌿](https://www.alexanarch.org/s/records/1099/)) — a recovered blog series from 2014–2015, framed as posthumous transcripts of email exchanges between Jack Feist and Rhys Owens. Whatever the relationship was then, it goes back far enough that it precedes the archive's formal architecture.

So: collaborator, theorist-practitioner, poet, and someone in the correspondence record from the beginning. The archive treats him with its full scholarly apparatus — contributor license, DOI registry, provenance document — the same infrastructure it gives the heteronyms. He's held here as himself.","navigate":null,"cast":null}]}
